items.label: Vertex cantor healthcare conference 2026 (09-10-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Head of IR Susie Lisa said Vertex will complete enrollment i

set.signal: Susie Lisa (Investor Relations) said Vertex will complete enrollment in its two phase III studies in diabetic peripheral neuropathy (chronic pain franchise) before the end of the year; both are 12-week studies, so data could come maybe by mid-2027. After the agency declined about a year ago to grant a broad peripheral neuropathic pain label from one DPN and one lumbosacral radiculopathy study, Vertex pivoted to a second DPN study, since two studies in any peripheral neuropathic pain category yield that indication. One study has about 1,100 patients across suzetrigine, placebo and a pregabalin arm, the second about 700 patients versus placebo, run at a more limited number of sites experienced in managing the DPN placebo effect. On the NaV1.7/NaV1.8 combination she said the next step is less about waiting on the DPN results than about seeing where the combination itself might go, in both acute and chronic pain.

items.reason: This source labels Susie Lisa only "Investor Relations"; the "Head of IR" title comes from another source (Wells Fargo transcript).

items.label: Vertex cantor healthcare conference 2026 (09-10-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Manisha Pai on the closed Crinetics deal: acromegaly is a sp

set.signal: Manisha Pai on the closed Crinetics deal: acromegaly is a specialty market treated by about 3,000 endocrinologists in the U.S., and Vertex plans to bring its rare-disease commercialization and ex-U.S. reimbursement expertise to accelerate the PALSONIFY launch and expand it globally. Of the potential $5 billion in peak sales, PALSONIFY is seen as a potential blockbuster and atumelnant, now in phase III for congenital adrenal hyperplasia, as a multi-billion dollar asset; Vertex is still getting its hands around timelines and will have updates later, including updated accounting and financial information on its Q3 call. On atumelnant liver safety she said only one liver enzyme elevation could not be ruled out as possibly related, with reversible AST/ALT elevations, no bilirubin elevation and no Hy's law cases; the data were shared with the FDA and other regulators, which did not ask for changes to monitoring protocols, and Vertex is confident in the safety profile based on the phase II data.

items.reason: Only the accounting and financial information is tied to the Q3 call; timelines get "updates later".
items.evidence: We just closed the transaction, so we are getting our hands around all of that, and we will have updates later, including updated accounting and financial information on our Q3 call.

items.label: Eli Lilly Morgan Stanley conference 2026 (09-14-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Ilya Yuffa on the U.S. oral GLP-1 launch: Lilly now has more

set.signal: Ilya Yuffa on U.S. launch metrics (the transcript names the brand Zepbound throughout this passage): Lilly now has more than 30% share in new starts within oral GLP-1, which he called a marked improvement in just the last two months of new starts, with progress in the covered commercial segment, Bridge and self-pay. Most starts are currently self-pay at lower initial price points until people get through to higher doses, a mix he said will shift over time. He said Lilly will continue to challenge its teams to get leading share with Foundayo, but would not commit to a time for getting there.
